description: PLA response rate broken down by page type for a marketplace over a period: ad requests, non-zero responses, and response rate (%), grouped by page_type (SEARCH / CATEGORY / PRODUCT / HOME / ...). No spend / no currency conversion. The Python layer computes total_requests, total_responses, and overall_response_rate from these raw aggregates.

page_type.description: The surface the ad served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...).

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received on this page type.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) on this page type.

response_rate.selector: ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2)
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = non-zero responses / requests * 100 for this page type.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_page_name_performance_facts` AS pf JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON pf.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND pf.page_type IS NOT NULL AND pf.page_type NOT IN ('', 'NA') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
